description: Buddy Phase 21 — Execution Unblock & Adaptive Tuning. Phases 1-20 built 73 modules (126/126 stories passed) but system has executed only 1 trade despite 10+ scans finding 0.70+ ensemble scores. Root causes: ThresholdOptimizer disabled with no feedback loop, regime classifier returning UNKNOWN, 70% zero-tradeable scans, config_adjustments.json empty. Phase 21 converts infrastructure into execution by wiring adaptive feedback loops, hardening regime detection, and logging block reasons for observability. DIRECTIVE: NEVER STOP. DONT ASK. ONLY ASK WHEN DESTRUCTIVE.

userStories.title: Wire ThresholdOptimizer feedback loop to gate evaluation
userStories.description: Enable ThresholdOptimizer and create a feedback loop so optimized thresholds are applied to gate evaluation each cycle, not just logged.
acceptanceCriteria: Set enable_threshold_optimizer=True in smart profile and balanced profile defaults
After ThresholdOptimizer.optimize() runs, write results to config_adjustments.json with timestamp and regime
In GateEvaluator or engine.py gate check, read optimized thresholds from ThresholdOptimizer and apply as overrides
Fallback to config defaults if optimizer has insufficient data (<15 trades)
Log threshold adjustments to observation_log with category 'threshold_tuning'
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Enabled in config.py smart profile. engine.py calls optimize_thresholds() after PairAnalysis built, can re-qualify blocked pairs if optimizer loosened threshold. Feeds optimized values to ConfigAdjuster for persistence. Falls back to defaults with <15 trades. Verified 2026-03-22.

userStories.title: ATR-based regime fallback when TCN model unavailable
userStories.description: Add a fallback regime classifier using ATR percentiles when TCN volatility model fails to classify (returns UNKNOWN).
acceptanceCriteria: In GateEvaluator or engine.py, detect when regime='UNKNOWN' or TCN model is None
Compute ATR percentile from recent candles: <25th=LOW, 25-50=NORMAL, 50-75=HIGH, >75=EXTREME
Set analysis.volatility_regime to fallback classification
Log regime fallback usage to observation_log with category 'regime_fallback'
Fallback only activates when TCN model unavailable or returns invalid
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Inserted in engine.py after regime_name assignment (line ~2453). Computes ATR percentile from last 100 candles using high-low range. Logs to observation_log with category regime_fallback. Only fires when regime_name=='UNKNOWN'. Verified 2026-03-22.

userStories.title: Trade block reason logging for every gate failure
userStories.description: When a pair fails any gate (confidence, momentum, risk, consensus, regime), log the specific reason and values to observations so the system can learn why trades are being blocked.
acceptanceCriteria: After gate evaluation in engine.py, if pair is NOT tradeable, log block reason
Block reason includes: which gate failed, threshold value, actual value, pair, regime
Log to observation_log with category 'trade_block_reason'
Only log for pairs that had ensemble score > 0.50 (filter noise)
Summary counter: track gate failure counts per gate type per cycle
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Added before cache in engine.py. Filters by confidence>0.30 and direction!=HOLD. Logs each failed gate (confidence, momentum, risk, volatility, consensus) with actual values vs thresholds. Metadata includes full gate status dict. Verified 2026-03-22.

userStories.title: Regime-specific agent consensus thresholds
userStories.description: Allow agent consensus requirements to vary by regime. In EXTREME volatility, require fewer agents to agree (market is directional). In LOW, require more (noise is high).
acceptanceCriteria: Create regime_consensus_map in config: LOW=0.50, NORMAL=0.33, HIGH=0.25, EXTREME=0.20
In agent consensus check (engine.py line ~1834), look up threshold by current regime
Fall back to config.min_agent_consensus_ratio if regime unknown
Log regime-adjusted consensus threshold to observation when it differs from default
Guarded by enable_regime_consensus config flag (default True)
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: regime_consensus_map added to ScannerConfig with defaults {LOW:0.50, NORMAL:0.33, HIGH:0.25, EXTREME:0.20}. Agent consensus gate in engine.py looks up threshold by analysis.volatility_regime. Falls back to config.min_agent_consensus_ratio for UNKNOWN regime. Guarded by enable_regime_consensus. Verified 2026-03-22.

userStories.title: Config adjustments persistence and application loop
userStories.description: Create a central config adjustment manager that collects recommendations from ThresholdOptimizer, ObservationConsumer, and DriftMonitor, persists them, and applies them to the running config.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/scanner/automation/config_adjuster.py with ConfigAdjuster class
collect_adjustment(source, key, value, reason) stores pending adjustments
apply_adjustments(config) applies all pending adjustments to ScannerConfig
Persist all adjustments to .claude/config_adjustments.json with timestamps
Rate-limit adjustments: max 1 change per key per 10 cycles
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Created config_adjuster.py (200 lines). ConfigAdjuster class with collect_adjustment(), apply_adjustments(), save_state(). Rate-limits 1 change/key/10 cycles. Persists to .claude/config_adjustments.json. Initialized in engine.py, applied every 10 cycles in continuous.py. Verified 2026-03-22.

userStories.title: Extreme regime execution policy: reduce size, don't block
userStories.description: In EXTREME regime, the system should still execute trades but with reduced position size (50% of normal) instead of blocking entirely.
acceptanceCriteria: In position sizing logic, detect EXTREME regime and apply 0.50x size multiplier
In EXTREME, lower confidence threshold by 5 points (e.g. 50 -> 45) to allow more signals
Log extreme regime position sizing adjustments to observation_log
If account drawdown > 5%, override: block all trades regardless of regime
Guarded by enable_extreme_regime_policy config flag (default True)
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Added in engine.py after ThresholdOptimizer apply. EXTREME regime: lowers effective_min confidence by 5pts, re-qualifies blocked pairs if risk_passed, applies 0.50x size multiplier via result.risk_pct. Already-tradeable EXTREME pairs also get reduced size. Config flags: enable_extreme_regime_policy, extreme_regime_size_multiplier, extreme_regime_confidence_offset. Verified 2026-03-22.
